relationships.subject: Nav1.7 I228M
relationships.evidence_quote: Expression of three canonical cLTMR marker genes: Th, Fam19a4 (Tafa4), and Slc17a8 (vGlut3) (Li et al., 2011) were significantly downregulated in HomNav1.7I228M compared to WT DRG neurons

relationships.subject: Nav1.7 I228M
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that both the total and TTX-sensitive (TTX-S) sodium current were significantly reduced in HomNav1.7I228M neurons compared to WT

relationships.subject: Nav1.7 I228M
relationships.evidence_quote: Penk, the gene encoding proenkephalin which is the precursor for the production of endogenous opioids, was the most up-regulated gene in our dataset

relationships.subject: Nav1.7 I228M
relationships.evidence_quote: aged (>18 weeks) HomNav1.7I228M animals surprisingly were insensitive to noxious heat and cold

key_findings: Aged homozygous Nav1.7 I228M gain-of-function mice develop thermal and pruritogenic insensitivity and skin lesions, with reduced sodium current despite the GOF mutation.
RNA-seq showed specific downregulation of C-LTMR genes (Th, Slc17a8, Fam19a4) and strong Penk upregulation, mirroring Nav1.7 knockout.
